title: Hypervolt 2 fails to start
shortDescription: Dead battery or power button firmware lock.
fullDescription:
Hypervolt 2 has a single power button that cycles through 5 speeds. If it won't start, the battery is likely depleted or the firmware needs reset.

Charge for 30 minutes; the LED ring should pulse amber during charge.

fixSteps.title: Charge 30 min
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in barrel jack; watch for amber LED pulse.

fixSteps.title: Long-press reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power button 10 seconds with charger disconnected.

fixSteps.title: Test
fixSteps.instruction: Short-press power — motor should start at speed 1.

whenToCallPro: If dead after full charge cycle.

title: LED ring red during use
shortDescription: Low battery warning — charge before next session.
fullDescription:
The Hypervolt 2 LED ring shows green (full), yellow (half), and red (low, <20%). A red ring during use means runtime is limited.

No action required other than recharging.

title: Device shuts off from overheating
shortDescription: Thermal cutoff after extended high-speed use.
fullDescription:
After extended use at speeds 4-5, the brushless motor may reach its thermal limit and shut down. The LED may flash red.

Cool for 15 minutes before restarting and avoid maximum speed for long sessions.

fixSteps.title: Check vents
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure air vents are not covered.

faq.a: No, normal use should never trigger it.

title: Head wobbles or falls off mid-use
shortDescription: Worn attachment stem or incorrect seating.
fullDescription:
Hypervolt attachments push-fit onto the shaft with an o-ring. If they wobble, the o-ring may be worn or the attachment not pressed fully.

Press firmly until you feel the click; replace attachment if cup is cracked.

fixSteps.title: Inspect o-ring
fixSteps.instruction: Look for cracks on attachment stem.

title: Hyperice app cannot connect
shortDescription: Bluetooth pairing failure — usually permissions or cache.
fullDescription:
Hypervolt 2 Pro connects to the Hyperice app for guided routines. If pairing fails, clear prior pairings and ensure Bluetooth + location permissions are granted.

Device enters pairing mode when powered on for first 60 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Forget in settings
fixSteps.instruction: Remove Hypervolt from phone's Bluetooth pairings.

title: Charger LED dark / no charge
shortDescription: Adapter or cable fault preventing charging.
fullDescription:
Hypervolt 2 uses a 24V 2A barrel-jack adapter. If the LED does not light when plugged in, test the outlet and inspect the barrel connector for damage.

Use only Hyperice-rated 24V adapters — lower voltage will not work.

fixSteps.title: Test outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Plug different device to check mains.

fixSteps.title: Wiggle barrel plug
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure full insertion with no wobble.

title: Grinding or clicking noise
shortDescription: Bearing wear or loose internal component.
fullDescription:
Hypervolt 2 is advertised as quiet (~54 dB). Noticeably louder or grinding noises indicate bearing wear or foreign debris.

Stop use and contact Hyperice — continuing risks motor damage.

fixSteps.title: Run no-load test
fixSteps.instruction: Run 30 seconds in air to confirm.

fixSteps.title: Submit warranty
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Hyperice support with video of noise.

title: Power button doesn't click or cycle speeds
fullDescription:
The Hypervolt 2 power button integrates LED and speed control. Sticky feel or failure to cycle speeds usually indicates sweat/oil ingress.

Clean gently around button with isopropyl on cotton swab.

fixSteps.title: Clean button
fixSteps.instruction: Cotton swab with isopropyl around button edges.

fixSteps.title: Verify cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Power on and confirm all 5 speeds available.

whenToCallPro: If button remains stuck after cleaning.
